modes.name: 灯芯の補助石
modes.targetScope: R/SR and base constant<=1.4; active wearer only
modes.description: echo attack reference = max(own unbuffed battle attack after leader stat bonus,min(65,own unbuffed battle attack after leader stat bonus+24)); native cooldown3 and35% nonrecursive echo; fixed crafted T3 proxy power80/traitnone/pure only; no opening barrier The65/70 bound caps the substituted reference floor, NOT final damage or buff/acceleration. Original own attack is never reduced.

modes.name: 分灯の共鳴石
modes.targetScope: R/SR and base constant<=1.4; active wearer only
modes.description: echo attack reference = max(own unbuffed battle attack after leader stat bonus,min(70,floor(mean other living ally unbuffed battle attack after leader stat bonus*0.9))); native cooldown3 and35% nonrecursive echo; fixed crafted T3 proxy power80/traitnone/pure only; no opening barrier The65/70 bound caps the substituted reference floor, NOT final damage or buff/acceleration. Original own attack is never reduced.

modes.name: 星図の露出
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: ordinary personal area hitting>=2 enemies leaves strength30 defense debuff through next round on surviving targets; preserves stronger effect

modes.name: 余光の包帯
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: ordinary personal heal/mend_pair excess raw healing*0.6 -> barrier capped min60,20% recipient maxHP; max with existing, through next round Shield helper replaces only if new capped amount>old active amount; expiry=max(old expiry,next round). Otherwise amount and expiry remain unchanged. This single native barrier layer can inherit an existing longer duration.

modes.name: 祈りの余韻
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: ordinary personal heal/mend_pair grants barrier min55,18% recipient maxHP; max with existing, through next round; no charge Shield helper replaces only if new capped amount>old active amount; expiry=max(old expiry,next round). Otherwise amount and expiry remain unchanged. This single native barrier layer can inherit an existing longer duration.

modes.name: 守りの返し
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: after actual intercepted ordinary enemy HP damage and surviving, one counter per guardian per round, reference attack min60,20% guardian maxHP; native armor/barrier/guard apply; no counter recursion; no bossStrike or bits hook

modes.name: 再診の呪印
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: ordinary personal ailment failed (including random miss) -> strength20 defense debuff next round, max with stronger; no effect on success; ward/existing/random failures counted separately; not jam

modes.name: 重ならない祈り
modes.targetScope: frozen previous bottom20 and current candidate only
modes.description: ordinary personal buff cannot lower existing stronger buff and duration; no free extension beyond max old/native duration; no added gauge Only strictly stronger previous buffs are protected; equal-strength expiry shortening is not fixed.

warnings: No game main or live content changed
Fixed bottom20 skill targets are a research instrument for individualized redesign, not a proposed invisible equip restriction
Stone cutoff is explicit but still creates an eligibility cliff; exact UI/acquisition unresolved
Effects keep the original ordinary skill action and cooldown; no permanent stats changed
No claim that these are all possible rescue designs

getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.stoneReference: one per boosted primary gem hit; never native echo tick
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.areaMark: one per surviving marked recipient, not per action
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.eligibleHealTargets: one per recipient of an ordinary personal heal/mend_pair
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.overhealShield/aftercareShield: one per successful amount increase, existing stronger barrier can suppress it
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.guardCounter: one actual intercepted HP-hit-triggered counter per round; no shield-only, bossStrike, bits or recursion
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.controlWardResist/controlExistingResist/: reason subdivisions for failed ordinary ailment, not jam
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.fallbackDebuff: one per failed ordinary ailment; success gives zero
getPrototypeStatsInterpretation.preservedBuff: only strictly stronger existing buff protected

checks.name: flat stone adds an active reference without persistent stat changes
shared stone requires living peers and bounded reference
area marking needs multiple enemy targets and preserves stronger debuffs
overheal is capped and never stacks or downgrades existing barrier
aftercare can trigger without overhealing and keeps limits
guard counter fires once despite two intercepted HP hits
absorbed guard hits do not trigger a counter
control fallback discriminates ward and random failures; successes get nothing
buff preservation protects strong value and old expiry without extra extension
individual skill prototypes do not apply to an unselected candidate
active stone and custom content remain active after wave transition
documented limitation: equal strength previous buff duration is not protected

mechanismQA.scope: micro fixtures deliberately set trigger conditions; not representative win-rate tests
